text:
ben_l: follow-up from the RFC review: propose a light-touch 'capability ping' before we commit big streaming state (kvcache, pinned tensors). idea is pre-accept probe to confirm upstream can do resumable streaming + cheap fast path.

tara_w: hmm, how is this different from health checks / existing pre-warm probes?

ben_l: healthchecks are coarse and not per-request. this ping is per-request, O(1KB) probe, returns a signed capability assertion. if upstream says it can't stream, we take buffered path and skip expensive allocations.

samir_k: security: cannot send user auth in extra probe. do we sign something?

ben_l: yes. frontdoor emits a short-lived capability token (no user creds). token includes nonce, target-model, ttl(20s), and flags like resumable=1. proxy verifies signature from control-plane. no PII.

jen_ops: ops concerns: extra RTT, new header churn, rollout complexity.

ben_l: tradeoffs: small extra RTT on cold requests but big memory savings overall. we can make it async/nonblocking: if ping doesn't return within 30ms treat as NO_CAPABILITY and fall back. also feature-flagged per-customer.

samir_k: retries/side-effects: if ping says TRANSIENT, do we hedge? what about non-idempotent calls?

ben_l: proposal: ping result = {CAPABLE, UNCAPABLE, TRANSIENT}. For TRANSIENT, gateway may issue a single-hedge to an alternate pool only when idempotency header present or when request marked safe. For UNCAPABLE -> buffer. Never auto-hedge non-idempotent requests.

tara_w: header sketch:

```
X-Cap-Ping: v1; model=redwood-7b; ttl=20; sig=...
X-Cap-Result: CAPABLE|UNCAPABLE|TRANSIENT
```

ben_l: store result in ephemeral request metadata; expose metrics: cap_ping_latency_ms, cap_result_{capable,uncapable,transient}, hedges_from_ping. Log ping_id for correlation.

jen_ops: rollout plan? canary? opt-out for Dedicated?

ben_l: rollout: behind feature flag. start 1% global with canary on non-prod clusters, then 10% then wide. Dedicated customers get toggle in console + default off.

infra-bot: checklist: crypto lib for verifying tokens is infra-crypto v0.10, rate-limit pings to 100rps/node, created ticket RNF-5142 for a prototype.

samir_k: compatibility: if upstream ignores ping or returns 404 -> treat as UNCAPABLE. backwards compatible.

tara_w: good. please add small sequence diagram and the proto for token in RFC doc. also add observability docs and playbook for debugging hedges.

ben_l: will do bump RFC and PR. tagging @tara_w @samir_k @jen_ops for review. :thumbsup:

jen_ops: thanks — will coordinate with SRE for canary window.
